scenes: Shade is something we hold up together.
A shaded workplace needs permission, maintenance and water. | A heat warning needs someone able to act on it. | And a break needs to be possible without losing the day’s income.
Different entry points, one shared commitment. | Tell us what you work on, and what you could bring.
